_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Dir sidd Spiller {player_id} am Dräi-Spiller-Tic-Tac-Toe.
Däi Symbol ass '{symbol}'.
Dir huecht ënnereneen Ären Symbol op enger 5x5-Plat ze setze fir eng Linn vun véier ze bilden.
Linne kënnen horizontal, vertikal oder diagonal sinn.
Äre Zuch äreechen Sie mat der Format '[4]' fir Zell 4 ze markéieren.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Falschen Zuchformat. Benotzt '[cell]' wou Zell 0-{max_cell} ass.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ongëlteg Zellnummer: {cell}. Muss tëscht 0 an {max_cell} sinn.
invalid_move.made_invalid: De Spiller {player_id} huet en ongültegt Spill gemaach.

game_action.placed: Spiller {player_id} setzt säi Symbol ({symbol}) an der Plaz ({row}, {col}).
